set.body:
Outcome

Treat file order and encoded scalar representation as explicit I/O concerns while producing native image4s and Ravel images without legacy full-volume staging.

Work

- Decode NIfTI payloads directly into one Ravel destination or a justified immutable strided source view.
- Preserve native stored dtype, slope, intercept, and value semantics through image4s EncodedSampled; materialize Float or Double only by explicit policy.
- Stream NIfTI output in file coordinate order without copyLegacyLinear or a second full values buffer.
- Make sform and qform selection, coordinate convention, units, non-spatial axes, and conflicting-header policy explicit.
- Keep compressed and uncompressed peak-memory behavior measured separately.
- Give mutable Scala Array interop explicit copy-from and copy-out names using canonical order only.

Acceptance

- Read and write paths allocate no legacy full-volume value array in addition to the owned Ravel destination.
- Native dtype and scaled-domain reads have coordinate-exact round trips across asymmetric 3-D and 4-D fixtures.
- Header ambiguity and unsupported encoding fail with typed errors rather than silent reinterpretation.
- Peak memory and throughput receipts cover .nii and .nii.gz representative workloads.
- JVM I/O tests and shared JVM or Scala.js codec tests pass as applicable.
set.title: Stream NIfTI and encoded image IO without legacy staging buffers
